similarity.reason: Both independently researched community independents support civil equality, climate action, integrity and private enterprise. Spender’s fiscally neutral shift from labour taxes toward asset-income concessions differs from Steggall’s early investment-tax objections and later rent-cap/housing programme; their AUKUS, public-service and innovation evidence also has distinct limits. Separate constituencies and subject-specific records justify retaining both despite 98.3% diagnostic similarity.
